images.alt:
A close, centered portrait shows a fantastical, catlike Mad Hatter figure staring directly toward the viewer with an enormous toothy grin. His face is covered in pale gray-white fur with darker charcoal markings around the forehead, cheeks, and eyes. The eyes are dramatically mismatched, one glowing amber-orange and the other icy blue, both framed by heavy reddish lids and sharply angled brows that intensify his mischievous expression. Wild, wiry red-orange hair explodes outward from beneath an oversized battered black top hat wrapped with a broad dusty rose band. A large, brightly patterned bow tie fills the lower center of the image, its splashes of turquoise, pink, orange, yellow, and black contrasting with his dark, worn clothing. At the lower left, an ornate metal teacup and saucer sit close to him while pale smoke or steam curls upward in thick translucent coils. Small candle flames glow softly through the darkness on both sides of the figure. The background fades into deep teal-black shadows, allowing the fiery hair, mismatched eyes, colorful bow tie, candlelight, and drifting smoke to dominate the theatrical composition. 

Keywords: Mad Hatter, cat, top hat, teacup, red hair, mismatched eyes, grin, bow tie, candles, smoke, dark fantasy
